messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: TiltBridge pilot: request for reduced uptime SLO & capped credits

Team —

Quick summary: TiltBridge (Anna Reed) is asking for a temporary SLO concession for a 90‑day pilot. They want us to accept a 99.5% uptime commitment for the pilot window (we normally require 99.95% for pilots with production traffic) and to cap any service credits to 2% of the monthly invoice. In exchange they're committing to a 6‑month paid pilot at a 15% discount on reserved capacity and want fast onboarding.

Why they're asking: they have a legacy inference pipeline that will be moving workloads over incrementally; their early traffic patterns are bursty and they want softer uptime terms while they validate the integration. They are sensitive to large credit exposure — legal flagged the 99.95% credit formula.

Mitigations proposed by engineering/product:
- Priority routing to dedicated pool for the pilot
- Extra monitoring + daily health calls for first 14 days
- A hard cap on total credit exposure and a guaranteed rollback to our standard SLO after the pilot

Attachments: TiltBridge_SOW_v1.pdf, TiltBridge_risk_assessment.xlsx (see attached)

Ask: I need executive ratification for the concession (uptime 99.5%, credit cap 2%) and approval on a one‑time 15% pilot discount. If we get a quick thumbs up we can surface the redlined SOW to legal and send DocuSign.

If you'd rather chat, I can set a 20‑minute sync with Anna and Legal — available today 3–4pm PT.

Thanks,
Avery
Avery Johnson | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: TiltBridge pilot: request for reduced uptime SLO & capped credits

Avery —

Thanks for the summary and the SOW. Heads up: this is a precedent request that needs executive signoff. Finance will push back on a 15% across‑the‑board discount for a pilot without committed minimums; legal will want to confirm language around the credit cap and term.

My read: we can probably support a temporary 99.5% pilot SLO if we tighten the credit cap (recommend 1% instead of 2%) and shorten the pilot to 60 days. We should also require an explicit fallback to standard SLOs at pilot end and a clause that credits cannot be applied against previously invoiced usage.

Looping in Jonas and Lauren for exec ratification.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Deal Desk
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: TiltBridge pilot: request for reduced uptime SLO & capped credits

Acked. High level position: I am willing to approve a limited concession for a pilot but with firm constraints. Conditions for my approval: 
1) Reduce pilot length to 60 days (not 90).
2) Cap service credits to 1% of the monthly invoice (absolute maximum).
3) Add an engineering mitigation plan — priority routing + an initial 14‑day operations window where we provide a dedicated oncall.
4) No change to long‑term pricing or SLOs — explicit clause that SLO returns to standard terms at pilot end or on earlier detection of production load.

If legal clears the credit language and Finance verifies the commercial tradeoff (15% pilot discount tied to signed 6‑month commitment to convert), I will sign off. Please circulate redline that includes these items and I'll provide an exec signoff email.

Jonas
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Anna Reed <anna@tiltbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: TiltBridge pilot: request for reduced uptime SLO & capped credits

Thanks Jonas — that set of constraints is reasonable. Anna, quick note to confirm TiltBridge can accept a 60‑day pilot (instead of 90) and the 1% capped credit exposure. Per Jonas, this is a one‑time concession and we will revert to standard SLOs after the pilot; the 15% discount is conditioned on execution of the 6‑month paid conversion within 30 days of pilot completion.

Anna — can you confirm TiltBridge legal is okay with the 1% cap and the shortened pilot? If yes, I'll have Marissa circulate a redline and send to legal/finance for final clearance and DocuSign.

On the logistics: engineering will stand up priority routing and a 14‑day elevated monitoring window. I'll arrange the daily health calls for the first two weeks.

Avery

Colleagues —

I have reviewed the proposed concession and the conditions Jonas outlined. I hereby approve the following nonstandard terms for the TiltBridge pilot, contingent on legal signoff on the credit language and Finance confirming the commercial tie to conversion: 

- Pilot duration: 60 days
- Pilot uptime SLO: 99.5% (temporary concession)
- Service credit cap: 1% of monthly invoice (absolute max)
- Pilot discount: 15% applied to reserved capacity during the pilot, conditioned on execution of a 6‑month paid conversion within 30 days of pilot end
- Operational mitigations: priority routing, 14‑day elevated monitoring and daily health calls for the first two weeks

Marissa — please push the redline to Legal and Finance and then loop me for a final DocuSign.

Approved,
Lauren Bishop | VP, Commercial Operations
